pages.text:
Is that goo?

Eeuw!

I want some too.

We are two.

How old are you?

Six hundred and thirty two?

I like blue. Do you too?

I choose two shoes.

Which do you choose?

We make lots of noise.

Whaaa!

eurgghhh...aargh!
I take a nap on Gogo’s back.
I stay upright all through the night.
The ball goes THWOCK! Buddy, you ROCK!
That’s what we do. How about you?
